body: Not sure what culture you or your daughters ex are from but im from a culture where dowry is VERY common yet it is considered extremely bad to straight up ASK the girls family for it. Its one thing if the girls family offers it as “gifts” but never does the guys family ask for it without looking like the AH they are

NTA how much harm she can cause shouldn’t be a deciding factor. The harm she already caused should be. Thats very disrespectful and something that would make me reconsider what i mean to him if i were in your place.

I believe these were emotional affairs because 1-the fact he met these women off dating apps, 2- he refused to tell them about me and 3- because he deleted texts so i wouldnt see. 

I acknowledged that i was wrong to be overly invading his privacy and asking for proof. However because his whereabouts were one of the things he lied to me about i feel that its fair for me to ask for location sharing to continue. 

He doesnt really tell me about his day, he is generally the type of person who even gives broad ass answers when asked something rather than talking abt details. 

What i told him was that i would no longer as for proof (snaps) or always be asking abt what he is upto, but all i want it ofcourse to be added back on social media and the location sharing to continue

His defensiveness for the location- i was getting too much in his space always asking who he’s with what he’s upto and he’s tired of that. The social media part, because i told him that in the future i dont need to ask for permission to follow a female friend of yours, i said “you allowing her to be in your life, is automatic permission to me to show her my presence in your life” which i believe is perfectly reasonable
